subject: DI01000091

h.en: A computer is a coordinated system

body.en:
Understand the idea

Hardware is physical equipment;software supplies executable instructions and associated data.

Explanation and application

  • Input,processing,memory/storage and output cooperate;the block diagram shows roles,not a literal motherboard wiring diagram.
  • System software includes operating systems/drivers;application software performs user tasks such as document editing.
  • Data must be encoded and stored;fast processing does not guarantee correct results when inputs/formulas are wrong.
Why is external storage not simply input-only?

It supports reading and writing persistent data.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Hardware physical equipment છે;software executable instructions તથા સંબંધિત data આપે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Input,processing,memory/storage તથા output સાથે કામ કરે છે.Block diagram roles બતાવે છે,motherboard wiring નહિ.
  • System softwareમાં OS/drivers તથા application softwareમાં document editing જેવા user tasks આવે છે.
  • Data encode/store થાય છે.Input/formulas ખોટાં હોય તો fast processingથી correct resultની ખાતરી નથી.
External Storage Input-only કેમ નથી?

તે persistent data read/write કરે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

The CPU executes instructions while memory,storage and interfaces supply data and services.

Explanation and application

  • CU coordinates instruction fetch/decode/control;ALU performs arithmetic/logical operations;registers hold immediate operands/state.
  • RAM normally loses contents without power;storage retains saved files.Cache/registers are not the same as long-term disk storage.
  • Capacity units and transfer rate differ;check whether decimal GB or binary GiB is stated rather than mixing them.
  • PSU converts/distributes required electrical power.Do not open a PSU or touch internal mains circuitry;stored energy may remain.
  • USB,HDMI,network and audio ports have different purposes,versions and limits.A matching connector shape alone does not guarantee all functions.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

CPU instructions execute કરે છે;memory,storage/interfaces data/services આપે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • CU instruction fetch/decode/control coordinate કરે છે;ALU arithmetic/logic કરે છે;registers immediate operands/state રાખે છે.
  • RAM સામાન્ય રીતે power વગર contents ગુમાવે છે;storage saved files રાખે છે.Cache/registers long-term disk નથી.
  • Capacity તથા transfer rate જુદાં છે.Decimal GB કે binary GiB આપ્યું છે તે તપાસો.
  • PSU જરૂરી electrical power આપે છે.PSU ખોલશો નહિ કે mains circuitry સ્પર્શશો નહિ;stored energy રહી શકે છે.
  • USB,HDMI,network/audio portsના purposes,versions/limits જુદા છે.Same connector shape એટલે બધા functions supported નહિ.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A peripheral transfers,stores or presents data;some devices perform both input and output.

Explanation and application

  • Keyboard/mouse enter commands;scanner digitises pages;monitor/projector present visual output.
  • Printers create physical output;check print technology,consumables,driver,paper and network permissions.
  • An external hard disk is secondary storage that reads and writes data,not simply a keyboard-like input device.
  • Install the correct trusted driver,select the intended device and test with nonconfidential sample material.Safely eject storage before removal when required.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Peripheral data transfer/store/present કરે છે;અમુક input તથા output બંને કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Keyboard/mouse commands આપે છે;scanner pages digitise કરે છે;monitor/projector visual output આપે છે.
  • Printer physical output આપે છે;technology,consumables,driver,paper/network permissions તપાસો.
  • External hard disk read/write કરતું secondary storage છે;keyboard જેવું input device જ નહિ.
  • Correct trusted driver લો,intended device પસંદ કરો તથા nonconfidential sampleથી test કરો.જરૂર મુજબ storage safely eject કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

An OS manages resources and provides services/interfaces so applications and users can work with the hardware.

Explanation and application

  • Functions include process scheduling,memory management,file systems,device I/O,accounts,permissions and error handling.
  • Multitasking,security,usability,hardware support and reliability are characteristics to evaluate;an OS is not just its desktop wallpaper.
  • Windows and Linux distributions provide graphical and command-line tools;versions and distributions differ in menus/packages.
  • Normal work should use appropriate user permissions;administrator/root access is not a default requirement for every task.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

OS resources manage કરીને applications/usersને hardware સાથે કામ કરવા services/interfaces આપે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Functionsમાં process scheduling,memory management,file systems,device I/O,accounts,permissions/error handling આવે છે.
  • Multitasking,security,usability,hardware support/reliability evaluate કરવાના characteristics છે;OS ફક્ત wallpaper નથી.
  • Windows તથા Linux distributions graphical/command-line tools આપે છે;versions/distributionsનાં menus/packages જુદાં છે.
  • Normal work માટે યોગ્ય user permissions લો;દરેક task માટે administrator/root જરૂરી નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

OS installation can erase data;use a disposable VM or explicitly authorised practice computer with verified backup and recovery.

Explanation and application

  • Check current OS requirements,license,compatible hardware,boot media integrity and teacher instructions before starting.
  • Read the selected target disk/partition before confirming;never overwrite a personal or institutional system for this practical without authorisation.
  • After installation,configure permitted accounts,drivers,updates and basic network settings;record actual version and tests,not a fictional completion screenshot.
  • Windows examples:dir,cd,mkdir,copy,type;PowerShell uses Get-Location,Get-ChildItem,New-Item,Copy-Item,Get-Content.Choose one shell and explain its syntax.
  • Linux examples:pwd,ls,cd,mkdir,cp,mv,cat,date,whoami.Use a dedicated practice folder and quoted paths containing spaces;avoid destructive recursive commands.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

OS installation data erase કરી શકે છે;verified backup/recovery સાથે disposable VM અથવા authorised practice computer લો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • શરૂ કરતાં પહેલાં current OS requirements,license,hardware compatibility,media integrity તથા teacher instructions તપાસો.
  • Confirm પહેલાં target disk/partition વાંચો;authorisation વગર personal/institutional system overwrite ન કરો.
  • Install પછી permitted accounts,drivers,updates/network settings સેટ કરો;actual version/tests નોંધો,fake completion screenshot નહિ.
  • Windows examples:dir,cd,mkdir,copy,type;PowerShellમાં Get-Location,Get-ChildItem,New-Item,Copy-Item,Get-Content છે.એક shell પસંદ કરીને syntax સમજાવો.
  • Linux examples:pwd,ls,cd,mkdir,cp,mv,cat,date,whoami છે.Dedicated practice folder તથા spacesવાળા quoted paths લો;destructive recursive commands ટાળો.

h.en: Application installation is a trust decision

body.en:
Understand the idea

Install only authorised,compatible software from a trusted official store,repository or vendor source.

Explanation and application

  • Check license,OS architecture,storage needs and the installer publisher/signature where available.
  • Decline unrelated bundled tools;do not bypass antivirus,licensing or institutional controls to make an installer run.
  • Test launch,save/open and the intended feature using sample data;document version and uninstall/rollback if the authorised test requires it.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

ફક્ત authorised compatible software trusted official store,repository/vendor sourceથી install કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • License,OS architecture,storage needs તથા ઉપલબ્ધ હોય તો publisher/signature તપાસો.
  • Unrelated bundled tools ન લો;installer માટે antivirus,licensing/institutional controls bypass ન કરો.
  • Sample dataથી launch,save/open તથા intended feature test કરો;version લખો અને authorised test મુજબ uninstall/rollback કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Use your own approved account and an eligible account-creation flow;never share passwords,recovery codes or verification codes.

Explanation and application

  • Follow the service/school eligibility rules and add recovery/security options privately.Account creation is a learner action,not something these notes perform.
  • Add an approved contact;compose a clear subject,greeting,message and signature.Check To,Cc,Bcc and attachments before sending.
  • Labels can organise one message in several categories;archiving is different from deleting.Creating a filter requires correct matching conditions and an intentional action.
  • Test filters on safe sample mail;review whether an action applies to existing conversations.Signature settings may differ across devices.
  • Use a draft for practice;do not send unsolicited bulk mail,real invitations or sensitive attachments as a demonstration.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

પોતાનું approved account તથા eligible account-creation flow લો.Password,recovery/verification codes share ન કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Service/school eligibility rules પાળો;recovery/security options privately ઉમેરો.Account learner બનાવે છે,આ notes નહિ.
  • Approved contact ઉમેરો;clear subject,greeting,message/signature લખો.Send પહેલાં To,Cc,Bcc તથા attachments તપાસો.
  • Labelsથી એક message અનેક categoriesમાં ગોઠવી શકાય;archive/delete જુદાં છે.Filterમાં matching conditions તથા intentional action જોઈએ.
  • Safe sample mailથી filter test કરો;action existing conversationsને લાગુ પડે છે કે નહિ જુઓ.Device મુજબ signature settings બદલાય શકે છે.
  • Practiceમાં draft લો.Demonstration માટે unsolicited bulk mail,real invitations/sensitive attachments ન મોકલો.

h.en: Gmail hands-on route:work in a draft

body.en:
Understand the idea

Menu names can vary;identify the function and verify the selected account before any action.

Explanation and application

  • Open the official account/service page,choose the appropriate create-account flow if eligible and follow verification privately;never record secret codes in the practical report.
  • In the approved contacts application,create a clearly fictional training contact and verify its name/address before saving.
  • Choose Compose,enter a descriptive subject and draft body,attach only approved sample content and review the recipient fields without sending.
  • Create a training label;build a narrowly matched filter,preview its scope and choose an intentional action such as applying that label.
  • Find signature settings,enter a neutral training signature,save and verify a new draft.Do not assume a mobile signature matches the desktop setting.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Menu names બદલાય શકે છે;function તથા selected account action પહેલાં verify કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Eligible હોય તો official account/service pageનું યોગ્ય create-account flow લો.Verification privately કરો;secret codes reportમાં ન લખો.
  • Approved contacts applicationમાં clearly fictional training contact બનાવી name/address verify કરીને save કરો.
  • Composeથી descriptive subject/draft body લખો.Approved sample જ attach કરીને send કર્યા વગર recipients review કરો.
  • Training label બનાવો.Narrow matching filterનું scope preview કરીને label apply જેવી intentional action લો.
  • Signature settingsમાં neutral training signature save કરીને new draftમાં verify કરો.Mobile signature desktop જેવી જ હોય એવું ન માનો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A cloud folder organises files but access settings determine who can see or change them.

Explanation and application

  • Create a descriptive folder,upload approved sample files/folders and verify the correct destination and completed upload.
  • Download an authorised file/folder and verify the downloaded copy;cloud location and local download are different copies.
  • Assign Viewer,Commenter or Editor only as needed.Review effective permissions,possible inheritance and organisation restrictions.
  • Test the intended link using an approved separate test identity;link possession is not a substitute for checking access.Remove access when the exercise ends.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Cloud folder files ગોઠવે છે,પણ access settings કોણ જોઈ/બદલી શકે તે નક્કી કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Descriptive folder બનાવો,approved sample files/folders upload કરો અને destination/completion verify કરો.
  • Authorised file/folder download કરીને copy verify કરો.Cloud/local download જુદી copies છે.
  • જરૂર મુજબ Viewer,Commenter/Editor આપો.Effective permissions,inheritance તથા organisation restrictions જુઓ.
  • Approved separate test identityથી link test કરો.Link હોવો એટલે access યોગ્ય હોવાની ખાતરી નહિ.Exercise પછી access દૂર કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Create a form around a clear purpose;collect only necessary information using approved training data.

Explanation and application

  • Choose suitable question types:short text,paragraph,choices,checkboxes and dropdowns.Required prevents blank submissions but does not prove truth.
  • Validate numeric ranges or text/email format where appropriate;test valid,invalid and boundary inputs.Email-format validation does not establish ownership.
  • Preview the form as a responder,then use the current Publish and responder-access controls rather than sharing the editor link.
  • Review response settings,linked spreadsheet access and any response-summary visibility.Close responses when appropriate and avoid unnecessary personal data.

Current publishing/responder guidance: [1](https://support.google.com/docs/answer/2839588?hl=en)
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Clear purpose માટે form બનાવો;approved training dataથી ફક્ત જરૂરી માહિતી લો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Short text,paragraph,choices,checkboxes/dropdown યોગ્ય પસંદ કરો.Required blank submission અટકાવે છે,truth સાબિત નથી કરતું.
  • યોગ્ય numeric range/text/email format validate કરો.Valid,invalid/boundary inputs test કરો.Email-format validation ownership સાબિત નથી કરતી.
  • Responder તરીકે preview કરો;પછી current Publish/responder-access controls લો,editor link share ન કરો.
  • Response settings,linked spreadsheet access તથા summary visibility જુઓ.યોગ્ય સમયે responses બંધ કરો;unnecessary personal data ટાળો.

Current publishing/responder guidance: [1](https://support.google.com/docs/answer/2839588?hl=en)

body.en:
Understand the idea

A useful form must reject invalid cases without blocking intended valid responses.

Explanation and application

  • Test blank required fields,valid selections,an out-of-range number and malformed email text.Record expected versus actual behaviour.
  • A numeric range check alone may allow decimals;if an integer is required,choose an appropriate supported validation rule and test fractional input too.
  • Check who can see responses and whether the response spreadsheet has broader access than the form.A syntactically valid address is not verified identity.
Does an editor link equal a responder link?

No.Roles and access must match the intended audience.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Useful form invalid cases reject કરે તથા intended valid responsesને block ન કરે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Blank required fields,valid selections,out-of-range number તથા malformed email test કરો.Expected/actual behaviour લખો.
  • Numeric range check decimals allow કરી શકે.Integer જોઈએ તો supported rule પસંદ કરીને fractional input પણ test કરો.
  • Responses કોણ જોઈ શકે તથા response sheetનું access વધુ broad છે કે નહિ જુઓ.Valid address syntax verified identity નથી.
Editor Link તથા Responder Link Same?

ના.Roles/access intended audience મુજબ હોવા જોઈએ.

body.en:
Aim and source duration

Inventory a powered-down training system without opening unsafe power equipment.

2 hours as listed;see syllabus-total discrepancy.

Tools and preconditions

Use the approved application/version and fictional sample data.Authorisation is required for installation,sharing and any real distribution.Never include passwords or private identifiers in evidence.

Procedure and checks

  1. Obtain permission and identify the assigned system;do not open PSU or mains enclosures.
  2. Identify input,processing,memory/storage,output and power roles from labels/manuals.
  3. Record CPU/RAM/storage information only from accessible approved screens or markings.
  4. Match ports to their intended peripherals without forcing connectors.
  5. Classify external storage as read/write storage and label units consistently.
  6. Prepare a labelled block diagram and authentic inventory evidence;redact serial/personal information if necessary.

Actual evidence and fault finding

Record what actually happened.Check wrong selection,permissions,missing initialisation,input/range errors and version differences before repeating.Do not claim that supplied expected values are measured/performed results.

Input / ActionExpected checkActual resultEvidence / Notes

————
body.gu:
હેતુ તથા Source Duration

Unsafe power equipment ખોલ્યા વગર powered-down training systemનું inventory કરો.

2 source-listed hours;syllabus-total discrepancy જુઓ.

Tools તથા Preconditions

Approved application/version તથા fictional sample data લો.Installation,sharing/real distribution માટે authorisation જોઈએ.Evidenceમાં passwords/private identifiers ન મૂકો.

Procedure તથા Checks

  1. Permission લઈને assigned system ઓળખો;PSU/mains enclosure ન ખોલો.
  2. Labels/manualsથી input,processing,memory/storage,output/power roles ઓળખો.
  3. Accessible approved screens/markingsમાંથી જ CPU/RAM/storage લખો.
  4. Connectors force કર્યા વગર ports/peripherals match કરો.
  5. External storageને read/write storage તરીકે classify કરીને units consistent રાખો.
  6. Labelled block diagram/authentic inventory બનાવો;જરૂર મુજબ serial/personal information redact કરો.

Actual Evidence તથા Fault Finding

Actual શું થયું તે લખો.Repeat પહેલાં wrong selection,permissions,missing initialisation,input/range errors તથા version differences તપાસો.Supplied expected valuesને measured/performed results ન કહો.

body.en:
Aim and source duration

Install only on a disposable VM or explicitly authorised training device.

4 hours as listed;see syllabus-total discrepancy.

Tools and preconditions

Use the approved application/version and fictional sample data.Authorisation is required for installation,sharing and any real distribution.Never include passwords or private identifiers in evidence.

Procedure and checks

  1. Check current OS requirements,license,teacher permission and recovery plan.
  2. Create a VM/snapshot or verify a backup of the authorised practice device.
  3. Obtain legitimate installation media from a trusted source and verify the intended version.
  4. Confirm the target virtual disk/partition before accepting any erase/format action.
  5. Complete permitted setup,accounts,drivers and updates without bypassing security controls.
  6. Test boot,login,file save and required networking;record actual observations and rollback if assigned.

Actual evidence and fault finding

Record what actually happened.Check wrong selection,permissions,missing initialisation,input/range errors and version differences before repeating.Do not claim that supplied expected values are measured/performed results.

Disposable VM અથવા explicitly authorised training device ઉપર જ install કરો.

4 source-listed hours;syllabus-total discrepancy જુઓ.

Approved application/version તથા fictional sample data લો.Installation,sharing/real distribution માટે authorisation જોઈએ.Evidenceમાં passwords/private identifiers ન મૂકો.

Procedure તથા Checks

  1. Current OS requirements,license,teacher permission/recovery plan તપાસો.

body.en:
Aim and source duration

Practise basic OS utilities in an isolated work folder.

4 hours as listed;see syllabus-total discrepancy.

Tools and preconditions

Use the approved application/version and fictional sample data.Authorisation is required for installation,sharing and any real distribution.Never include passwords or private identifiers in evidence.

Procedure and checks

  1. Create a dedicated practice directory and identify the shell/desktop version.
  2. Create,rename,copy and move sample files using the file manager.
  3. Use the calculator,text editor,screenshot and system-information utilities available in the assigned OS.
  4. Practise pwd/ls/cd/mkdir/cp/cat on Linux or the documented equivalent in the selected Windows shell.
  5. Inspect task/resource information without terminating unknown system processes or revealing private account/network details.
  6. Record commands,actual results and safe cleanup of only your assigned sample files.

Actual evidence and fault finding

Record what actually happened.Check wrong selection,permissions,missing initialisation,input/range errors and version differences before repeating.Do not claim that supplied expected values are measured/performed results.

Input / ActionExpected checkActual resultEvidence / Notes

body.gu:
હેતુ તથા Source Duration

Isolated work folderમાં basic OS utilities શીખો.

4 source-listed hours;syllabus-total discrepancy જુઓ.

Tools તથા Preconditions

Approved application/version તથા fictional sample data લો.Installation,sharing/real distribution માટે authorisation જોઈએ.Evidenceમાં passwords/private identifiers ન મૂકો.

Procedure તથા Checks

  1. Dedicated practice directory બનાવી shell/desktop version ઓળખો.
  2. File managerથી sample files create,rename,copy/move કરો.
  3. Assigned OSનાં calculator,text editor,screenshot/system-information utilities લો.

h.en: Practical-only assessment and inconsistent hour totals

body.en:
Understand the idea

The official scheme is L0,T1,PR4,credits3;theory ESE/PA are0and practical PA/ESE are20/30,total50.

Explanation and application

  • The unit-content hours sum to56;do not call them56lecture hours because L=0.
  • The35listed practical durations sum to86hours,while the PDF prints Total60Hours.Keep each approximate listed duration and flag the mismatch for the teacher.
  • Unit weightages14,32,14,22,18sum to100%;they are not an invented70-mark written paper.RBT theory distribution is NA.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ
